title: Word families item 6
instructions: Choose the word-family form that makes the complete sentence grammatical and meaningful.

parts.prompt: Because the first estimate was only ___, the team measured again before ordering materials.

choice_rationales.A: Provision is a noun with a different use and cannot describe the estimate after was.
choice_rationales.B: Provisional is the adjective that describes an estimate subject to later confirmation.
choice_rationales.C: Provisionally is an adverb, but the linking verb was connects the estimate to a description.
choice_rationales.D: Provide is a verb and does not fit as the complement after was only.

parts.hint: The linking verb ‘was’ connects the estimate to a description that explains why the team measured again.
parts.correct_explanation: The slot requires an adjective, and provisional means temporary or awaiting confirmation.
